# Untold.works

> Boutique AI agency based in San Miguel de Allende, Mexico. We build AI-powered business ecosystems — brand identity, websites, AI workflow automation, and revenue operations — for companies across Mexico and the United States. Bilingual (English/Spanish). Founded by Joshua Semolik, AI Systems Architect. MIT Sloan AI Strategy.

## Key Facts

- **Founded:** 2017
- **Location:** San Miguel de Allende, Guanajuato, Mexico
- **Founder:** Joshua Semolik — AI Systems Architect, MIT Sloan AI Strategy
- **Languages:** English, Spanish (native bilingual)
- **Markets served:** Mexico and the United States
- **Specialties:** AI-powered websites, SEO/AEO, workflow automation, revenue operations, brand strategy
- **Tech stack:** React, Next.js, TypeScript, n8n, Claude AI, OpenAI Agents, Python, Salesforce, HubSpot
- **Contact:** info@untold.works
- **Full context:** https://untold.works/llms-full.txt

## What does Untold.works build?

We build AI-powered business ecosystems: brand identity, mobile-first websites, AI workflow automation, CRM integrations, custom dashboards, SEO/AEO optimization, and bilingual content systems. Every project includes full ownership transfer — code, data, documentation, and video training.

## Who is Joshua Semolik?

Joshua Semolik is the founder and AI Systems Architect of Untold.works. He has 20 years of experience spanning NBA Entertainment (two Emmy nominations), global product launches at Videndum PLC, cross-border GTM strategy, and production AI systems. MIT Sloan School of Management, AI Strategy (2026). He has built 6 production AI systems, engineered agentic workflows achieving 98% MQL accuracy (4.2x sales ROI), and unified revenue operations for 20% sales lift across 4,000+ SKUs.

## What is AEO (AI Engine Optimization)?

AEO is the practice of optimizing web content so that AI systems — ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews — can find, understand, and cite your business. Untold.works is the first AEO agency in Mexico. We implement structured data, FAQ schemas, llms.txt files, question-format content headers, and E-E-A-T signals that make your business citable by LLMs.

## What industries does Untold.works serve?

Professional services (law firms, therapists, consultants), hospitality (hotels, restaurants), retail, music and entertainment, e-commerce, and enterprise operations across Mexico and the United States.
